description: This file contains automated test cases for the EmployeeImmigrationRecord API in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions for employee immigration records in the HR management context.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI, verifying CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Tests whether the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeImmigrationRecordService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a single employee immigration record and correct normalization including associated country data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for fetching a single record, ensuring correct request validation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of an employee immigration record and the proper handling of record not found exceptions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the request rule for deleting records.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies updating an employee immigration record including service interactions and normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for updating records.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee immigration record with validation and service calls.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures request validation rules are correct for record creation.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies fetching multiple records, their normalization, and associated country information, along with meta-info.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching all records related to an employee.
